claim_boundary: Exact fixed-modulus coloured Fourier/Gram/cubic identities, sharp completion and fibre-spacing barriers, elementary dyadic-shell accounting, and a conditional character-by-character fallback only. No coloured primitive cubic estimate, Hecke large-value theorem, zero-density theorem, detector, or prime-ideal theorem is proved.

coloured_energy.critical_scope: A coloured-energy-only substitution into the pinned refined S3 bound has maximal term TN|W|^2 on this permitted scale; this is not a P7 density-exponent calculation.
coloured_energy.exact_identity: E_col^=(W)=H^-1 sum_{g in G} integral_0^1 |sum_{(chi,t) in W}chi(g)e(t theta)|^4 dtheta.

finite_exact_check.spacing_bound: If every character fibre is delta-separated, fixing three points fixes the fourth colour and leaves at most floor(2Delta/delta)+1 fourth times.

coloured_energy.sharpness: W=X(f)x{0} has E_col^=|W|^3 although every fibre has one point.

complete_group_diagonalization.complete_sample_no_loss: For W=X(f)xS and equal ray-class mass N/H, the diagonal cubic scale is H^3*H*|S|*(N/H)^3=|W|N^3.
complete_group_diagonalization.diagonalization_criterion: B is ray-class diagonal exactly when every A_t is empty or all of X(f).

finite_exact_check.proper_subset_mixing: For the one-character subset, the exact off-diagonal Hilbert--Schmidt square is 1/2.

complete_group_diagonalization.positivity: B is an orthogonal projection and B(direct_sum_g C_g)B is positive semidefinite.
complete_group_diagonalization.selected_projection: B=UP_WU* has B_((g,t),(h,s))=1_(t=s)H^-1 sum_{chi in A_t}chi(hg^-1).

completion_barrier.implication: Trace positivity/completion alone does not preserve the Guth--Maynard selected-side diagonal cancellation unless kappa_f(W)=T^o(1) or a new selected-side estimate is proved.
completion_barrier.sharp_example: One globally separated point at a distinct time for each of H characters has kappa_f(W)=H.
completion_barrier.trace_comparison: For A=N I_m and a selected R-row compression with m=kappa R, the selected cubic excess is zero but replacing its cubic trace by tr(A^3) leaves (kappa-1)RN^3.

conditional_shell_reduction.conclusion: For R=sum_f R_f and E=sum_f E_f, sum_f R_f^(3/2)<=R^(3/2) and sum_f R_f^(1/2)E_f^(1/2)<=R^(1/2)E^(1/2); no separate number-of-moduli factor is forced at this formal homogeneous S3 summation step.
hypotheses: A selected-side primitive coloured fixed-modulus S3 estimate of source shape.
A same-scale control of the signed cross-conductor cubic contribution.

dyadic_shell.completion_loss: Fixed-modulus full-character completion can cost up to 2Q; a raw global uncoloured separation extraction can face O(Q^2) labelled fibres.
dyadic_shell.cross_conductor_term: X_cross(W;c)=tr(K^3)-sum_f tr(K_{W_f}^3) is generally signed and has no common ray-class Fourier group.
dyadic_shell.ideal_count_bound: For Q>=8, fewer than 6Q integral ideals of Z[i] have norm at most 2Q.

fixed_character_fallback.conductor_height_boundary: If Q=T^vartheta, the crude uniform bound carries T^(2vartheta); it is subpower only under an additional Q=T^o(1) restriction.
fixed_character_fallback.exact_loss_boundary: F_prim(Q) is unavoidable in this direct nonnegative character-by-character summation. The 12Q^2 bound is not a lower bound for all joint methods.
hypotheses: For every selected primitive chi, W_chi is 1-separated in [0,T] and |D_chi(t)|>=V.
D_chi(t)=sum_{N<n<=2N}A_chi(n)n^(it), with the P7 zero extension and one common dyadic N.
N<=T^C for a fixed C, so the P7-1 divisor normalization is T^o(1).
fixed_character_fallback.non_promotion: This is an automatic P7-1 plus Guth--Maynard application, not a new Hecke theorem; P7 detector and density implications remain unproved.
fixed_character_fallback.normalization: b_chi,n=A_chi(n)/Delta_N, Delta_N=max_{N<n<=2N}tau(n), has |b_chi,n|<=1 and changes V to V/Delta_N.

finite_exact_check.identity_mode_explanation: Only triples with all three ray classes equal survive the full-character coloured sums.

fixed_modulus_coloured_cubic.label_loss: None in the exact regrouping: all character labels are summed into the three coloured Fourier sums.
fixed_modulus_coloured_cubic.sample: W is a finite subset of X(f) times R, with the selected P7 primitive sample embedded in the complete ambient X(f).

missing_analytic_statistic.not_supplied_by_pinned_sources: Neither the integer Guth--Maynard theorem nor the P7-2 common-ideal L2 Hecke large sieve supplies the required selected-side primitive cubic estimate.
missing_analytic_statistic.required_bound: A colour-aware affine/Poisson estimate must control both quantities from coloured energy, local cross-character height information, and the exact primitive projector without a kappa completion or signed-projector triangle loss.
